settings.accuracyBody: BharatYatra uses scheduled Indian Railways timetable data (DataMeet / reference schedules). Special trains, seasonal changes, and live delays are not reflected automatically. Always verify on IRCTC / NTES before booking.
settings.coverageNote: Coverage may be incomplete for some regional or special trains.

settings.aboutBody: BharatYatra is an offline-first planner for two-ticket train journeys. All ratings are schedule-based estimates, never probabilities or live status. It does not book tickets or replace IRCTC / NTES / RailOne.
